chunks.arabic_text: ٤ - فَارِسُ بْنُ حَاتِمِ بْنِ مَاهَوَيْهَ، الْقَزْوِينِيُّ. فَسَدَ مَذْهَبُهُ (وَبَرِئَ مِنْهُ)، وَقَتَلَهُ بَعْضُ أَصْحَابِ أَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ الْحَسَنِ (عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ) بِالْعَسْكَرِ. لَا يُلْتَفَتُ إِلَى حَدِيثِهِ. وَلَهُ كُتُبٌ كُلُّهَا تَخْلِيطٌ.

translations.en: 4 – Fāris ibn Ḥātim ibn Māhawayh, al-Qazwīnī. His madhhab was corrupt [and barā’a was done from him]. One of the companions of Abū Muḥammad al-Ḥasan (peace be upon him) killed him. His ḥadīth are not turned to. He has a book, all of it is insane.

en.summary: This entry from al-Ghaddā'irī's *Kitāb al-Duʿāfā* highlights Fāris ibn Ḥātim al-Qazwīnī as a weak narrator whose theological deviation (*fasad madhhab*) led to his execution by companions of Imam al-Hasan al-ʿAskarī in al-ʿAskar. His narrations are largely disregarded (*la yultafat ilā ḥadīth*) due to the confusion and lack of precision in his works, reflecting the rigorous scrutiny applied to narrators during the Minor and Major Ghaibah periods to preserve doctrinal purity.
en.seo_question: Who is Fāris ibn Ḥātim al-Qazwīnī and why is his hadith considered weak?

key_terms.وَبَرِئَ مِنْهُ: And barā’a (disassociation) was done from him
key_terms.لَا يُلْتَفَتُ إِلَى حَدِيثِهِ: His hadith are not turned to (disregarded)
key_terms.تَخْلِيطٌ: Insanity/Confusion (referring to the nature of his books)
